# Irder

> > Irder is a marketplace connecting global buyers with Chinese manufacturers and wholesale suppliers, specializing in uniforms, workwear, medical supplies, and consumer products.

Irder operates as a B2B and B2C platform featuring instant video shopping capabilities and direct access to suppliers in major Chinese manufacturing hubs including Guangzhou and Shenzhen. The platform emphasizes drop-shipping, international shipping, and small-lot wholesale opportunities across categories like chef uniforms, medical uniforms, swimwear, and specialty products.

## Key Topics

- China manufacturers
- Wholesale suppliers
- Guangzhou sourcing
- Shenzhen manufacturing
- Uniforms and workwear
- Medical uniforms (TiaNex Medical)
- Chef uniforms (I Am Chef)
- Swimwear wholesale
- Drop-shipping
- International shipping
- Small lot wholesale
- FDA510k certified products
- Video shopping
- B2B marketplace
- Vendor directory
